name: app-nightlife-map-with-story-bubbles
title: Nightlife discovery map with circular story bubbles in neon
whatItIs: A tilted phone on a purple surface shows a dark map covered by circular photo bubbles with coloured neon rings and venue names, a floating search pill, and small badges.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and social; venue photos sit on the map like stories, making discovery feel alive.
techniques: Replace pins with circular photo avatars on the map.
Ring each avatar in a neon gradient to show activity.
Use a dark, muted map so imagery pops.
Float a translucent search pill above the map.
bestFor: Event, nightlife and local discovery apps

vocabulary.definition: A map marker made of a circular photograph.
A coloured ring around an avatar signalling new content.
A search field hovering above content.
